facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary endpoint, secondary signals positive · Phase 2 · ulixacaltamide in essential tremor · not yet approved

evidence.summary: ulixacaltamide treated participants demonstrated improvement relative to placebo participants in the primary endpoint, change from baseline to Day 56 in the modified Activities of Daily Living (“mADL”) score, that did not reach statistical significance.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: While improvements relative to placebo on the primary endpoint and nominal statistical significance on certain of the secondary endpoints were observed, the study did not meet the primary endpoint.
evidence.safety: There were no drug related serious adverse events (“SAEs”).
evidence.program_discontinued: The Company intends to engage with the FDA in an end of Phase 2 meeting and initiate a Phase 3 study for the treatment of essential tremor in the second half of 2023
